the incidence of recent HIV infections among STI patients is lower than among newly diagnosed HIV-1 infected individuals.

the Avidity test can help us to better identify recent HIV infections and to monitor the HIV/AIDS epidemic.
the ARL and the STI clinic are key sites for the surveillance of recent infections and that the ARL is the most appropriate site for monitoring trends in incidence.
